D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Ted Lieu leads by 57.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 153,393 votes; a one point swing is about 1,331 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +51.7 and D +63.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.2M cash against $912. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
